# interfere_scim_group_role_mappings (Resource)

Manage which workspace role each group in a SCIM directory grants, and their order. This resource owns every role mapping in the directory: groups left out of mappings have no role. When a member is in several mapped groups, the earliest mapping wins. Groups appear after the identity provider provisions them, and the directory must have group role mapping turned on. The directory itself, its connection and its SCIM bearer token stay outside Terraform; the token is never read or stored in state. Destroy removes the role from every mapped group. Import with workspace-slug/directory-id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "interfere_scim_group_role_mappings" "okta" {
  workspace_slug = "example"
  directory_id   = "scim_dir_2abc"
  mappings = [
    { scim_group_id = "00g1admins", role = "org:admin" },
    { scim_group_id = "00g1engineering", role = "org:member" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory_id` (String) Identifier of the SCIM directory whose group role mappings this resource manages.
- `mappings` (Attributes List) Group role mappings in precedence order; earlier mappings win when a member is in several groups. Each group may appear once. An empty list removes every mapping. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mappings))
- `workspace_slug` (String) Workspace URL slug, using lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the SCIM directory, the same as directory_id.

<a id="nestedatt--mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `mappings`

Required:

- `role` (String) Workspace role granted to members of the group: org:owner, org:admin, org:member (Developer), org:product, org:support, org:viewer, org:billing or org:auditor. You can grant only a role whose permissions you hold.
- `scim_group_id` (String) Identifier of the group in the SCIM directory, as the identity provider provisioned it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import interfere_scim_group_role_mappings.okta example/scim_dir_2abc
```
